messages:
amanda: ACME retest window set Wed 10-12 UTC. We need a short access + evidence playbook. Who can own end-to-end?

raj: I can own RBAC (ephemeral role). confirm resources: k8s ns=inference-prod, s3 prefix=redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026, kms alias=alias/ci/model-key.

lina: oncall-sre here. I will export CloudTrail + k8s audit, compress and upload shas to the evidence bucket.

oliver: suggest a tiny manifest per resource with fields: type,start,end,sha256,command,key_id,run_id,triage_owner,extension_procedure. Put manifests under /manifests/.

amanda: Agreed. Naming: <resource>-<start>.json. Include network_restrictions and the exact IAM role policy snippet.

raj: Ephemeral role plan: 1h TTL, pre-approved 2h buffer. Sample cmd for assessors:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-ephemeral --role-session-name acme --duration-seconds 3600
```
Restrict to GET/PutObject on evidence prefix and k8s view for inference-prod; deny kms:* and iam:*.

oncall-sre: Add runbook line for extensions: create PR infra/pt-requests; auto-grant if both approvers (@raj @lina) approve within 15m.

lina: Export commands (example):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z --query Events > cloudtrail.json
gzip cloudtrail.json && sha256sum cloudtrail.json.gz > cloudtrail.sha256
kubectl --namespace inference-prod get events -o json > k8s-audit.json
gzip k8s-audit.json && sha256sum k8s-audit.json.gz > k8s-audit.sha256
aws s3 cp cloudtrail.json.gz s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-2026/logs/
```
All outputs + .sha256 files uploaded to S3.

oliver: KMS: export DescribeKey, key policy JSON, and rotation status with timestamp; put under /kms/.

amanda: Triage lead = oliver. Create security/triage/acme-retest.md and link it in manifest under triage_sheet.

security-bot: Jira created SEC-PT-4521 assigned raj,lina,amanda https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-PT-4521

amanda: Action items: raj=PR for role; lina=log export+smoke test; oliver=triage sheet+manifest links; oncall-sre=monitor window. Post s3 links here when done.

lina: Uploads scheduled Tue 18:00 UTC. I will post links after upload.

raj: Draft PR opened https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/834 (ephemeral role + policy).

amanda: Please ensure manifest includes verbatim commands, timestamps, sha256s, key ids, and run ids. I will review Wed 08:00 UTC. Reminder: retention 90 days; open SEC-PT-4521-EXT if assessors need longer.
